kjv: he (Jesus) distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down
mine: he (Jesus) distributed them to those who were seated
note: TR adds the disciples as intermediaries, from Mt 14:19.

kjv: He that believeth on me (Jesus) hath everlasting life
note: TR adds "eis eme" (on me); absent from P66, P75, Sinaiticus, B.

kjv: thou (Jesus) art that Christ, the Son of the living God
mine: you (Jesus) are the Holy One of God
note: TR assimilates Peter's confession to Mt 16:16; P75, Sinaiticus, B, C*, D read "the Holy One of God", a rarer title (cf. Mk 1:24).
